# Lessons and corrections

Every experiment was audited by a separate agent ("gate"), working from the code, tables and run records rather than
the author's summary. The auditors share the authors' model family, so their independence comes from the task split
and from re-deriving numbers. This chapter collects what they caught and what was done about it. Superseded results
stay in Git history and in the journals; they are not deleted.

| # | Problem | Found by | Consequence | Fix | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Source scale 100 µg s⁻¹ gave per-sample SNR ~1e-3: sensors saw no plume | gate-00 B1 (estimate); confirmed by E02 (SNR ~2e-3), E03 (all 648 fits rank-deficient), E04 (practical rank 0/4), E05 (0 in every cell) | No placement or inverse result was interpretable | **A1:** a_ref = 1 g s⁻¹; noise, background, winds, seeds, endpoints unchanged. Peak SNR now 21–32 | Fixed; results at 1 g/s exploratory because the value was chosen after seeing data |
| 2 | First-order upwind at 64²: effective diffusivity 350–2900 m² s⁻¹ vs K = 50; dt-halving gate fails | gate-00 B3 (risk); B3 study and lead's independent check | 64² runs would have studied numerical, not physical, diffusion | **A2:** dimensionally split VanLeer at dt 30 s; K_eff ≈ 50, order ≈ 2, dt-halving ≤ 0.71 % | Fixed for 64²; ~1 % non-linearity measured and shown negligible for E07 |
| 3 | FiPy VanLeer as shipped is explicit and, unsplit, anti-diffusive across oblique winds | B3 study | Naive switch would have blown up (×1e8 in 1 h at Courant 5.8) or been anti-diffusive | Courant guard in `simulate`; Lie splitting | Fixed |
| 4 | E03 `rank_info` reported a finite condition number for rank-deficient matrices | E03 work | Misleading conditioning | cond = ∞ unless rank equals the number of columns | Fixed |
| 5 | E05 v1: "longer window helps / substitutes for sensors" | gate-05 | Window effect was the "steady" wind drifting ~30° between blocks; mean tables dominated by blow-ups up to 1e23; ties scored as "contradicted" | v2: exactly constant null wind, drifting as its own level, prior-based ridge, medians, seed as unit, DiD contrast | Corrected; v1 labelled superseded |
| 6 | E06 performance was in-sample and the POD archive encoded the true strengths | gate-06 | Advantages of source-informed designs overstated; "training-only" meant hours, not information | E07: declared knowledge per design, prior-ensemble POD archive, held-out winds, AR(1)/per-site arms, mode-count rule fixed in advance, swap/exhaustive checks | Built into E07 before any computation |
| 7 | E06 greedy optimality was checked only where spacing never binds | gate-06 | Greedy D exact in only 35/80 binding cases | 1-swap refinement and a binding-block exhaustive check in E07 (greedy + swap exact 146/160 in the sweep) | Fixed |
| 8 | "D-opt beats random" could be read as "optimisation helps" | gate-07 issue 2 | source_near beats dopt in 115/120 pairs | Credit sentence attached to every statement of the confirmatory result | Wording fixed; exclusion control done (gain falls to 0.20) |
| 9 | Confirmatory scope smaller than the protocol's K × N grid | gate-07 issue 1 | 8 cells run vs protocol's N ≥ 8 cells over K ∈ {2, 4, 8}; cells not run are "unresolved" | Verdict stated as "supported in the cells run" | User approved (2026-11-13) |
| 10 | Percentile bootstrap of a median at n = 10 is anti-conservative | gate-07 issue 5 | One cell straddles with distribution-free CI | Distribution-free and mean-bootstrap variants reported (7/8 and 8/8) | Fixed |
| 11 | A2 quoted the superposition error over 96 h only | gate-07 issue 7 | Full calendar error is ~27× larger (0.73σ max) | Added to the A2 decision; impact on RMSE ≤ 1e-4 | Fixed |
| 12 | Endpoint agreement presented as a finding | gate-07 issue 8 | It is close to built in (same static estimate, perfect model) | Labelled as structural, not general | Fixed |
| 13 | Fisher/CRB intervals badly miscalibrated under a wrong noise model | gate-04 | CRB-based uncertainty unsafe under misspecification | Not fixed; noted for E14 (calibration) | Open |

## What these corrections taught us

- **Check the signal-to-noise ratio first.** Three experiments were run before the scale problem was acted on; a
  one-line estimate in the protocol audit had already predicted it.
- **A "steady" control must be exactly steady.** The E05 confound came from a realistic-looking jitter in the control.
- **Means of ill-posed estimates are meaningless.** Use medians, prior-referenced regularisation, and count failures.
- **Always include a dumb control that knows the same thing.** The locations-only control is what revealed that the
  E06/E07 gains were mostly knowledge of source locations.
- **In-sample information is not held-out performance.** Whole-period D on training (and even on test) winds missed the
  short windows in which a source became invisible.
- **Amendments are fine if recorded.** Each change above has a decision file or journal entry with its evidence and
  the results it affects.
